# WAMU: Digitize your savings group on WhatsApp

> WAMU is a WhatsApp-based platform for running savings groups in Uganda: VSLAs (Village Savings and Loan Associations), SACCOs (Savings and Credit Cooperatives), investment clubs and merry-go-rounds. Members contribute by MTN Mobile Money or Airtel Money inside WhatsApp, and every contribution and payout is recorded automatically in a shared ledger. There is no app to download.

## What WAMU does

- Replaces the treasurer's paper notebook with an automatic, tamper-resistant shared ledger every member can verify.
- Runs entirely inside WhatsApp, with no app install and no smartphone requirement beyond WhatsApp itself.
- Collects contributions and sends payouts through regulated mobile money rails (MTN MoMo, Airtel Money).
- Verifies every member's identity before they can send or receive funds.
- Calculates merry-go-round (ROSCA) rotation order, dates and amounts automatically.
- Tracks SACCO share capital separately from savings, with per-member dividend calculations and board-ready reporting.

## Who it is for

- VSLAs / Village Savings and Loan Associations
- SACCOs / Savings and Credit Cooperatives
- Investment clubs and pooled investment groups
- Merry-go-round / rotating savings circles (ROSCAs)

## Company

WAMU is operated by WAMU PAY (UGANDA) LIMITED, a Uganda-registered company. Records and money movement are aligned with Uganda's payment systems and cooperative law and its data protection principles. Groups get started by messaging WAMU on WhatsApp at +256 788 003344 (https://wa.me/256788003344).
